recap.text: Katia opens a silver box from Princess Formidable and finds ten bolts of Petrify Rock Class. Carl realises the igneous is Maggie, and a crossbow bolt to the head leaves her Petrified on the street under a sixty-second timer. Imani says Chris is petrified too, with an Infiltrator controlling him. Katia fires into his chest, the bolt whiffs away in smoke, and the timer resets; with three bolts left, three minutes is not enough to reach the stairwell.

beats.headline: Ten bolts from a princess
beats.text: Katia has received an emergency benefactor box, a silver one from Princess Formidable, and Mordecai says she needs to open it now: it probably cost the princess a sizeable chunk of her net worth. Then Carl realises the igneous in front of him is not Chris but Maggie. She pulls a round, spiked ball, and a crossbow bolt slams into her head. The rock creature crashes to the street, Petrified, a sixty-second timer overhead. Katia jogs up: her box held a set of ten bolts of Petrify Rock Class. The creature's eyes still move; she is conscious but cannot move. Why, Katia asks, give her bolts to petrify Maggie instead of kill her?
beats.gist: Katia's silver box holds ten Petrify Rock Class bolts, and one turns Maggie to stone.

beats.headline: Seven minutes left
beats.text: Imani stops them: Chris has messaged her. He is petrified, and he is being controlled. Juice Box says there is an Infiltrator in him, and she is the one to kill. At ten seconds Mordecai says shoot him again; Katia fires into his chest, the bolt whiffs away in a puff of smoke, and the timer resets. An Infiltrator takes full control of a living body, Mordecai explains, and getting her out without killing him is next to impossible. Katia fires her third of ten. Seven more minutes. When Katia is down to three bolts, three minutes is not enough to get him to the stairwell.
beats.gist: Katia fires bolt after bolt into petrified, controlled Chris, resetting the timer each time.
